text:
Priya Rao: claiming slot 57 in the catalog for onboarding Halite-2b:v2. planning to pin at 2026-03-20 15:00 UTC (that's 08:00 PDT). Who's available to run quick smoke tests and watch the canary?
Alex Kim: I can do the smoke window at 08:00 PDT. will run the perf + sanity script.
Li Wang: I'll validate model outputs against the eval set (prompt consistency + token drift). expecting ~20m.
Jordan Patel: I'll stand by for rollback if needed. Marcos, can you handle infra-side rollbacks?
Marcos Silva: yep, i'll prepare the rollback playbook and keep the slot reserved. what are the exact pin config and rollout size?
Priya Rao: rollout plan: 10% traffic for first 15m, then 50% for 30m if green, then 100%. pin config snippet below:
```json
{
  "model": "halite/2b:v2",
  "pin_to_slot": 57,
  "traffic_split": "canary=10,gradual=50,full=100",
  "variants": ["fp16", "int8-q4"]
}
```
Priya Rao: smoke checks: 1) health endpoints, 2) sample prompts sanity, 3) latency P50/P95 within baseline, 4) no diff in regen tests >5%
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued by Priya Rao for halite/2b:v2 -> slot 57. CI checks: unit tests ok, image built.
Alex Kim: running smoke script now: `/scripts/smoke_halite.sh --slot 57 --sample 200`
Li Wang: starting evals against eval-v2 set (consistency + toxicity heuristics). will post results.
Marcos Silva: rollback playbook ready: `pin revert slot=57 -> previous=halite/2b:v1` ; infra check list: drain, disable slot, revert alias, confirm metrics.
Jordan Patel: if we see latency p95 > baseline+30% or >1% failure/regressions on eval set, trigger rollback.
Priya Rao: agreed. i'll also monitor cost and KV-cache behavior. tagging @eng-oncall: ops-bot, we'll need a watch for the first 30m.
ops-bot: Alert channel subscription added: #eng-oncall watching slot-57 pin. Automated alerting on errors>0.5% or p95 spike > 50%
Li Wang: quick heads-up: small regen divergence on a few prompts (3/200), sharing diff link: https://internal.redwood/evals/halite-v2/2026-03-20
Alex Kim: saw the diffs, looks like safe variation — not hallucinations. marking as acceptable for canary.
Priya Rao: ok launching canary at 08:00 PDT. i'll post a follow-up with timestamps and final verdict. thanks all. :party-parrot:
